text_en: Now the company of prophets said to Elisha, “As you see, the place where we live under your charge is too small for us.
text_cn: 众先知的弟子对厄里叟说：“看，我们同你住的地方太窄小了，

text_en: Let us go to the Jordan, and let us collect logs there, one for each of us, and build a place there for us to live. ” He answered, “Do so. ”
text_cn: 请你让我们到约但河去，每人取一根梁木，在那里建造我们的住所。”他答说：“你们去吧！”

text_en: Then one of them said, “Please come with your servants. ” And he answered, “I will. ”
text_cn: 其中一个人说：“请你也同你的仆人一起去！”厄里叟答说：“我去。”

text_en: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down trees.
text_cn: 先知便同他们一起去了。他们到了约但河，就砍伐树木。

text_en: But as one was felling a log, his ax head fell into the water; he cried out, “Alas, master! It was borrowed. ”
text_cn: 其中一个，砍木梁时，斧头掉在水里了，就大声叫喊说：“哎哟！我主，这把斧子是借来的啊！”

text_en: Then the man of God said, “Where did it fall? ” When he showed him the place, he cut off a stick, and threw it in there, and made the iron float.
text_cn: 天主的人问他说：“斧头掉在那里？”那人将那地方指给先知看。先知即砍下一块木头，丢在那里，使斧头浮了上来。

text_en: He said, “Pick it up. ” So he reached out his hand and took it.
text_cn: 先知对他说：“你拿上来吧！”他就伸手拿了上来。

text_en: Once when the king of Aram was at war with Israel, he took counsel with his officers. He said, “At such and such a place shall be my camp. ”
text_cn: 阿兰王同以色列交战时，与自己的臣仆商议说：要在某某地方埋伏。

text_en: But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, “Take care not to pass this place, because the Arameans are going down there. ”
text_cn: 但天主的人打发人去见以色列王说：“你要小心提防，不要经过某某地方，因为阿兰人已在那里设下埋伏。”

text_en: The king of Israel sent word to the place of which the man of God spoke. More than once or twice he warned such a place so that it was on the alert.
text_cn: 以色列王就派人去侦察天主的人警告他的地方；他就小心防备，不只一两次。

text_en: The mind of the king of Aram was greatly perturbed because of this; he called his officers and said to them, “Now tell me who among us sides with the king of Israel? ”
text_cn: 阿兰王为了此事心中颇为烦恼，遂将臣仆召来，对他们说：“难道你们不能告诉我：我们中谁支持以色列王吗？”

text_en: Then one of his officers said, “No one, my lord king. It is Elisha, the prophet in Israel, who tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedchamber. ”
text_cn: 一个臣仆答说：“我主，大王！没有谁支持，只有以色列的先知厄里叟，将君王在密室里所谈的事，都告诉了以色列王。”

text_en: He said, “Go and find where he is; I will send and seize him. ” He was told, “He is in Dothan. ”
text_cn: 阿兰王说：“你们去看看他在那里，我好派人去捉拿。”有人告诉君王说：“他在多堂。”

text_en: So he sent horses and chariots there and a great army; they came by night, and surrounded the city.
text_cn: 阿兰王就打发马队战车和强大的部队前去，夜间到了那里，将城围住。

text_en: When an attendant of the man of God rose early in the morning and went out, an army with horses and chariots was all around the city. His servant said, “Alas, master! What shall we do? ”
text_cn: 天主的人的仆人清早起来出门时，看见军队车马将城包围了，就对先知说：“哎！我主，我们怎么办？”

text_en: He replied, “Do not be afraid, for there are more with us than there are with them. ”
text_cn: 先知答说：“不必害怕，因为偕同我们的，比他们的还多。”

text_en: Then Elisha prayed: “O Lord , please open his eyes that he may see. ” So the Lord opened the eyes of the servant, and he saw; the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
text_cn: 厄里叟就祈祷说：“上主，求你开启他的眼，叫他看见。”上主就开了仆人的眼，他看见遍山都是火马车，围绕着厄里叟。

text_en: When the Arameans came down against him, Elisha prayed to the Lord , and said, “Strike this people, please, with blindness. ” So he struck them with blindness as Elisha had asked.
text_cn: 敌人下到先知那里的时候，厄里叟恳求上主说：“求你打击这个民族，使他们眼目失明。”上主果然照厄里叟的话打击了他们，使他们眼目失明。

text_en: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, and this is not the city; follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek. ” And he led them to Samaria.
text_cn: 厄里叟对他们说：“不是这条路，也不是这座城；你们跟我来，我要领你们到你们寻找的人那里去。”于是先知领他们到了撒玛黎雅。

text_en: As soon as they entered Samaria, Elisha said, “O Lord , open the eyes of these men so that they may see. ” The Lord opened their eyes, and they saw that they were inside Samaria.
text_cn: 他们一进了撒玛黎雅，厄里叟就祈祷说：“上主，开启这些人的眼睛，叫他们看见。”上主果然开了他们的眼睛；他们一看，见自己竟在撒玛黎雅城内。

text_en: When the king of Israel saw them he said to Elisha, “Father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them? ”
text_cn: 以色列王看见他们，就对厄里叟说：“我父，要杀死他们吗？”

text_en: He answered, “No! Did you capture with your sword and your bow those whom you want to kill? Set food and water before them so that they may eat and drink; and let them go to their master. ”
text_cn: 厄里叟答说：“不要杀他们；你自己用弓剑掳来的人，你岂可杀死？你要为这些人预备饭和水，叫他们吃喝，然后让他们回到自己的主上那里去。”

text_en: So he prepared for them a great feast; after they ate and drank, he sent them on their way, and they went to their master. And the Arameans no longer came raiding into the land of Israel.
text_cn: 君王就给他们预备了盛宴，叫他们吃了喝了，打发他们回到自己的主上那里去。从此，阿兰队伍再没有侵犯以色列地方。

text_en: Some time later King Ben-hadad of Aram mustered his entire army; he marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.
text_cn: 这事以后，阿兰王本哈达得集合了他所有的军队，上来围困撒玛黎雅。

text_en: As the siege continued, famine in Samaria became so great that a donkey’s head was sold for eighty shekels of silver, and one-fourth of a kab of dove’s dung for five shekels of silver.
text_cn: 撒玛黎雅被围困后，陷于严重的饥荒，甚至一个驴头，值八十"协刻耳"银子，四分之一"卡步"豆荚，值五"协刻耳"银子。

text_en: Now as the king of Israel was walking on the city wall, a woman cried out to him, “Help, my lord king! ”
text_cn: 当以色列王从城墙上经过时，有一个妇人呼求他说：“我主大王，救救我吧！”

text_en: He said, “No! Let the Lord help you. How can I help you? From the threshing floor or from the wine press? ”
text_cn: 君王答说：“如果上主不救你，我怎能救你？靠禾场？靠酒池？”

text_en: But then the king asked her, “What is your complaint? ” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son; we will eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow. ’
text_cn: 君王问那妇人说：“你有什么事？”妇人答说：“这个女人曾对我说：把你的儿子交出来，我们今天吃；留下我的儿子，我们明天吃。

text_en: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son and we will eat him. ’ But she has hidden her son. ”
text_cn: 于是我们就把我的儿子煮着吃了。第二天我对那女人说：把你的儿子交出来给我们吃，她却把自己的儿子藏了起来。”

text_en: When the king heard the words of the woman he tore his clothes—now since he was walking on the city wall, the people could see that he had sackcloth on his body underneath—
text_cn: 君王听了这妇人的话，就撕裂了自己的衣服，──当他正在城墙上经过，民众都看见了他贴身穿着苦衣，──

text_en: and he said, “So may God do to me, and more, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat stays on his shoulders today. ”
text_cn: 说：“如果沙法特的儿子厄里叟的头，今天还留在他身上，愿天主严厉，且加倍严厉地惩罚我！”

text_en: So he dispatched a man from his presence. Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Before the messenger arrived, Elisha said to the elders, “Are you aware that this murderer has sent someone to take off my head? When the messenger comes, see that you shut the door and hold it closed against him. Is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him? ”
text_cn: 那时厄里叟正坐在屋里，长老们同他坐在一起，君王派一个人在他以前去，但是这人还未来到，厄里叟就对长老们说：“你们看，这个凶手之子，竟派人来要斩我的头。你们注意，使者来到时，你们要把门关上，把他关在门外；在他后面不就是他主上的脚步声吗？”

text_en: While he was still speaking with them, the king came down to him and said, “This trouble is from the Lord ! Why should I hope in the Lord any longer? ”
text_cn: 先知还同他们说话的时候，君王就下到他那里说：“这灾难是由上主来的，我对上主还有什么指望？”
